title: Portugal 1996 Hand-Painted Tudor Cottage Miniature House Figurine Village
conditionDescription: Small white flecks and light wear on the base grass and roof edges; small chip on the underside edge of the base. Felt intact. No breaks.
descriptionText:
Hand-painted miniature Tudor-style cottage marked "1996 PORTUGAL" on the front gable, with "Portugal 1996" handwritten on the green felt bottom. Cream half-timbered walls, red tile roof with dormers and a stone chimney, front steps and door, a side balcony, and a garden base with a winding path, stone wall, shrubs and a large tree.
Measures about 4 1/4 inches across the base (see the photo with the tape measure). A nice piece for a tabletop or Christmas village display.
Condition: Pre-owned display piece. Paint is bright overall, with a few small white flecks and light wear on the grass of the base and roof edges, and a small chip on the underside edge of the base next to the felt (see the last photo). Felt is intact with light lint and wear. No breaks or missing pieces. Please review all photos - they are of the actual piece you will receive.
